description: Count the calling tenant's own posts. Takes no parameters: the tenant is the one the service token names, and no other tenant's figures can be asked for.

main.description: Returns post counts for the calling tenant: all time, and over the last 24 hours and 7 days, for hosted posts and for registered remote posts. A tenant with no posts gets zeros, not an error. Needs the tenant's service token and no acting actor. Counts only: nothing here names an author or enumerates a post. Every figure was taken at the one read time `asOf`, so `prompts` plus `replies` equals `posts` in each, and a caller that keeps the answer can say how old it is.

posts.description: Hosted posts: those Antiphony stores and whose records it mints.

remotePosts.description: Remote posts the tenant registered: records held in other repos. Counted apart from `posts`, never in it. A remote post's window is its record's own `createdAt`, not when it was registered.

asOf.description: The read time every count was taken at, and the end of both windows.
